summary: BI-6EA9E25A (EP-6B33A840 L0.1). Migration 20260926030000_principal_locale_preferences adds two nullable preference columns to Principal. Additive; existing rows stay NULL, which resolves to the org default and browser negotiation exactly as today. No backfill.

fields.name: preferredLanguage
fields.reason: A display preference: a BCP-47 tag from the closed supported-locale registry in @dpf/i18n. Not personal data about a subject beyond a UI setting; retained and deleted with the Principal.
fields.provenance: Set by the person via setLocalePreferences, validated against the locale registry.

fields.name: timeZone
fields.reason: A display preference: an IANA timezone name validated by Intl.DateTimeFormat. Retained and deleted with the Principal.
fields.provenance: Set by the person via setLocalePreferences.
